title: Broadway to Cheyenne
description: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.

title: Raiders of the Border
description: U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E16 — Mysterious Decoy
Hooded vigilantes are involved in a boundary dispute.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E17 — Ridge of Ghosts
A gold watch is the only clue to a string of murders.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E18 — Hang the Jury
The agents investigate a hanging judge in Oklahoma for the state authorities.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E22 — Rawhiders
Agents go to Washington territory to investigate an imposter posing as a U.S. Secret Service agent.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E12 — Honeymoon Hotel
Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E13 — A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E14 — Cannonball Christmas
Homer plans to keep the Cannonball from making its Christmas caroling tour.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E15 — Herby Gets Drafted
Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E19 — Eyes of Texas
Even though Judge Roy Bean temporarily loses his eyesight, he's still able to uncover a plot to steal Indian land.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E02 — Family Ties
In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. They've learned that a railroad will need the property, and they intend to make an undeserved profit.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E12 — The Fugitive
Thieves posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher to steal his land and property.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E21 — The Hidden Truth
Judge Bean discovers that a young vagabond he jailed for a minor offense might be involved in a major unsolved gold heist.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E32 — The Hypnotist
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, a con involving the Haunted Hills draws Judge Roy's attention.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E09 — Judge Declares a Holiday
The judge meets up with a con man who comes to towns and arranges horse races; he then skips town with the receipts and all the money that was bet.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Judge's Dilemma
A gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false misconduct charges.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Katcina Doll
Shorts and Hurley hold a doll hostage that brings good luck to a Mexican village.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Arizona Thunderbolt
description: A circus performer (Joe Cook) and his piano-playing partner (Robert Cummings) go after a pair of ruthless rustlers.

title: The Diamond Trail
description: A New York reporter (Rex Bell) follows a gang of gem smugglers west.

title: Son of the Renegade
description: A man (John Carpenter) takes over a ranch left by his outlaw father.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E26 — Water Rights
A crooked stagecoach driver accuses Cisco and Pancho of stealing $50,000 from him.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E01 — Boomerang
A prominent investment broker is captured after scheming to have two of his men impersonate Cisco and Pancho at a bank hold-up.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E04 — Big Switch
A clever criminal hopes to rob a wealthy rancher, but Cisco and Pancho bring the man to justice.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E05 — Convict Story
An escaped convict is nearly murdered while trying to prove that he did not commit a crime.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E23 — Black Jack Ketchum
An outlaw convinces the son of a former gang-member to join his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E24 — Tom Horn
Matt's old friend, Tom Horn, turns into an outlaw and starts a land war.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E10 — The Last Viking
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E11 — The Trail Gang
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E12 — The Savage
Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E13 — Silent Thunder
Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: Fast Bullets
description: Two Texas Rangers (Tom Tyler, Rex Lease) nab smugglers and rescue a woman (Margaret Nearing) from a runaway wagon.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E06 — Oil Land
After being wrongfully jailed on a murder charge, Cisco and Pancho escape to capture the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E07 — Chain Lightning
Cisco is challenged by a man who seeks revenge after being jailed.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E08 — Medicine Flats
Cisco and Pancho hope to imprison the leader of a rustling ring.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E09 — Railroad Land Rush
A con man resorts to murder in a phony land promotion scheme.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E01 — Belle Starr
Matt Clark and Frankie Adams pursue a female outlaw named Belle Starr after her gang steals a herd of horses from the U.S. cavalry.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E02 — Billy the Kid
Matt teams with Pat Garrett after a large herd of horses is stolen.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E03 — Frank and Jesse James
Matt and Frankie go to Kansas City to aid in the capture of outlaw brothers Frank and Jesse James.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E04 — Geronimo
When the Apache chief leads a raid on a train depot, looking for weapons and provisions, one of his braves is captured.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E25 — Washington Story
Surveyor George Washington aids a young woman whose land grant is threatened by a wicked innkeeper.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E26 — Winter Passage
Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E27 — The Reckoning
More unrest between the white men and the Ottawas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E28 — La Salle's Treasure
Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle; they ask Hawkeye to lead them but when he discovers that it is in a sacred Dakota burial ground he tries to dissuade them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E29 — The Prisoner
Lt. Briggs breaks the treaty by chasing an Indian beyond the recognized border; led into an ambush he escapes but his militiamen are captured; Hawkeye and Chingachgook are assigned to escort him to his court-martial and probable hanging.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E30 — False Faces
A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent Mingo False Faces.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E31 — Morristown Story
Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away and told that the town is closed due to an outbreak of the black plague; Hawkeye decides to sneak in and see for himself.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E32 — Revenge
A young lieutenant seeks blind vengeance for the brutal murders of his parents by warmongering Shawnee.

title: Man From Music Mountain
description: A radio-singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) turns sheriff to save a sheep woman (Ruth Terry) from a cattleman (Paul Kelly).

title: Down Texas Way
description: Three U.S. Marshals (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) work undercover to foil a gang of racketeers.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: The Dawn Rider
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

title: The Lawless Frontier
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) protects a girl (Sheila Terry) and her father (George Hayes) from a rustler and a sheriff.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
description: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: Leather Burners
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) helps his friend Johnny (Jay Kirby) find out where rustlers are hiding stolen cattle.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: Daniel Boone
description: The frontiersman (George O'Brien) leads settlers to Kentucky, where a white renegade (John Carradine) unites tribes against them.

title: Cry Blood, Apache
description: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.
